results.summary_before: This design demonstrates a 4-bit binary counter that displays its decimal value on a 7-segment display, with manual clock and reset buttons. The counter increments on each button press and wraps from 9 back to 0, using a BCD counter and a BCD-to-7-segment decoder. External hardware includes two push buttons, a pull-down resistor, a 4-bit counter IC, an AND gate, a BCD decoder, and a common-cathode 7-segment display. The documentation is detailed but the pin names only show a single NAND gate, which does not match the described counter system.
